CorrectAddress.description_en: Corrects errors in address text entered by users
CorrectAddress.description_zh: 对用户输入错误文本地址进行纠错

ExtractAddress.description_en: Extracts address segments from unstructured data
ExtractAddress.description_zh: 从非结构化文本中抽取地址片段

ExtractName.description_en: Extracts name segments from natural text
ExtractName.description_zh: 从自然文本中抽取姓名片段

ExtractPhone.description_en: Extracts phone number segments from natural text
ExtractPhone.description_zh: 从自然文本中抽取电话号码片段

GetAddressDivisionCode.description_en: Identifies the four-level administrative divisions (province, city, district/county, and street/town) from the input address text
GetAddressDivisionCode.description_zh: 识别输入地址文本中的省、市、区(县)、街道(镇)四级区划

GetAddressSimilarity.description_en: Determines whether two addresses are the same address and returns the finest-granularity level at which the addresses match
GetAddressSimilarity.description_zh: 判定两个地址是否为同一地址，并给出最细粒度的相同地址级别

GetZipcode.description_en: Returns the postal code that corresponds to a specified address
GetZipcode.description_zh: 输入地址，输出地址所对应的邮政编码

StructureAddress.description_en: Classifies an original address into hierarchical levels and supports auto-completion of province, city, district, and street information
StructureAddress.description_zh: 针对原始地址进行分级，同时支持省、市、区、街道补全
